name: Desloppy
author: Dottti
description: Find the lines that make your writing sound like AI, and fix them in your own voice. AI score, line-level fixes, document checks and before/after compare. OAuth sign-in, free key with just an email.

tools.name: check_writing
tools.description:
Full check: does this read as AI-written, which passages to rewrite first, and how to fix each problem.
Returns verdict, ai_score (0 human .. 1 AI), passes (true = good to go), summary_markdown (a ready-made
summary), rewrite_first, top_fixes, voice_tips and line-numbered findings. `kind`: school_essay | essay | presentation | email | social | fiction | general | auto (guess)

tools.name: quick_fixes
tools.description:
Instant rule-based check (no detector, free): AI phrases and patterns for this kind of writing, each with a
line number and a plain fix, plus style signals and readability tips. Suited to quick checks while editing. `kind`: school_essay | essay | presentation | email | social | fiction | general | auto (guess)

tools.name: ai_score
tools.description:
AI-detector score only: overall verdict, confidence and a score per ~300-word chunk (0 = human, 1 = AI).
Max 20,000 words per call. `kind`: school_essay | essay | presentation | email | social | fiction | general | auto (guess)

tools.name: check_file
tools.description:
Full Desloppy check of a document: .docx, .pptx (slides + speaker notes), .pdf, .txt, .md. Give `path` when the
server runs on the same machine, or `file_base64` + `filename` otherwise. Returns the check_writing result plus
the extracted text's word count. `kind`: school_essay | essay | presentation | email | social | fiction | general | auto (guess)

tools.name: compare
tools.description:
Score an original and a rewrite side by side: AI score, verdict, pattern counts and whether the rewrite
passes. Shows whether a rewrite now reads as human. `kind`: school_essay | essay | presentation | email | social | fiction | general | auto (guess)

prompts.name: humanize
prompts.description: Rewrite a text so it no longer reads as AI-generated, checked by Desloppy after every round.

resources.name: tips
resources.description: Plain tips for writing that doesn't read as AI, for one kind of writing.
